name: Process Pennylane Invoice Requests
description: Issue a finalized Pennylane invoice from a Basic-auth POST and optionally wait for confirmation that its email was accepted.
requirements: Self-hosted n8n with a synchronous HTTPS webhook
Pennylane company API token with customers:all and customer_invoices:all scopes
Trusted invoice callers with explicit authorization for email delivery
